test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'BACKED' is coded as 'GHNFDE' and 'CLOSER' is coded as 'UHVROF'. How will 'JUNIOR' be coded in the same language?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7ec0eabb919cbe378f6c60e586fd3eadda9f9cbced99516ee3b9ac365925d20.png] 

**Logic:** **3 is added in all letter's positional values and written diagonally.**

'BACKED' is coded as 'GHNFDE' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e70bfeae02c41fc2a296a4c5bac443c10a876c9db4e5aafdf838ffa80386fcf6.png] 

'CLOSER' is coded as 'UHVROF' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8efab67b674d42f776b8cdc49a570c0e6650dc075f5da255695eea0d80215e1.png] 

Similarly, 'JUNIOR' will be coded as: →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b59c242990a4249a2ade2fa136521c483784861003d4297c6cb6eb69b0ca2426.png] 

Here, 'JUNIOR' is coded as** 'URLQXM'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
